create_transform_hierarchy: create a Transform hierarchy with parent and child nodes for a 3D scene graph
set_transform_position: set the 3D position of a Transform node using a numpy array or Vectors object
rotate_transform_with_quaternion: rotate a Transform node using a Quaternion to set its orientation in 3D space
get_world_transform_matrix: get the computed 4x4 world transformation matrix for a Transform node in the hierarchy
look_at_direction: orient a Transform node to face a target direction using the look_at method with a forward vector
